scope: Locked TRAIN_C5_24 development cohort only; no VAL/TEST raw, no new Plant, no real-wind fields, no inertia reconstruction/use.
model: GRU(14,32) -> Linear(32,3), zero-initialized output; per-scene hidden reset

training.normalizer: per-fold mean/std computed from training scenes only across 1999 causal X14 rows
training.position_loss: SmoothL1(clamp(a_C5 + beta*clip(delta,-0.5,0.5),-3,3), y_10ms_clipped) on ready events
training.task_loss: 0.1 * mean(SO3 geodesic angle in radians squared) over the exact 1-ms filtered command trajectory on frozen parent-C5 states; no normalization, threshold, or adaptive gate

gradient_adjoint_check.saturation_derivative_convention: matches torch.clamp: derivative 1 exactly at the limit, 0 outside

filter.initial_state: parent raw initial Euler and zero Euler-rate
filter.filter_reference_timing: pre-update; roll/pitch from current yaw, target yaw from reference

training.state_frozen_limit: The loss measures command/target consistency on fixed C5 state, yaw, and reference trajectories. It does not propagate residual-induced state changes or establish closed-loop performance.

holdout_W00_05.normalizer_fit_scope: train scenes only, all 1999 causal X14 rows

holdout_W06_10.normalizer_fit_scope: train scenes only, all 1999 causal X14 rows

holdout_W11_13.normalizer_fit_scope: train scenes only, all 1999 causal X14 rows

holdout_W14_15.normalizer_fit_scope: train scenes only, all 1999 causal X14 rows

limits: Development OOF of residual head on parent-seen DEV24 trajectories; not independent full-system validation.
Task-aware objective is a frozen-state surrogate; changes to position/yaw states and their later task commands are not modeled.
